_avail.description: Amplified Loudspeaker Controller - 2 Channels X 3200W + DSP Dante
_avail.portsMissing: The front-panel USB / serial service port is reserved for servicing and is not modelled

ports.label: Line In 1
ports.notes: Balanced line input, 20 kOhm; Ch 1-2 share one 6-pole 3.81 mm Phoenix (MC 1,5/6-ST-3,81)

ports.label: Line In 2
ports.notes: Balanced line input, 20 kOhm; Ch 1-2 share one 6-pole 3.81 mm Phoenix (MC 1,5/6-ST-3,81)

ports.label: Speaker Out 1
ports.notes: Lo-Z (2/4/8 ohm) or 70 V / 100 V by DIP switch; Ch 1-2 share one 4-pole 7.62 mm Phoenix (PC 5/4-STF1-7,62); bridgeable as a pair

ports.label: Speaker Out 2
ports.notes: Lo-Z (2/4/8 ohm) or 70 V / 100 V by DIP switch; Ch 1-2 share one 4-pole 7.62 mm Phoenix (PC 5/4-STF1-7,62); bridgeable as a pair

ports.label: Ethernet
ports.notes: 100 Mb control and monitoring (ArmoniaPlus), separate from the Dante port

ports.label: Alarm (GPO)
ports.notes: Fault/alarm contacts, one NO + one NC per channel; 6-pin Phoenix

ports.label: Remote Level
ports.notes: Remote level per channel (Ch 1 or Master, Ch 2) by 10 kOhm linear potentiometer; 6-pin Phoenix

ports.label: Remote On/Off
ports.notes: Remote ON / OFF by 5-24 V DC differential; 4-pole 3.81 mm Phoenix (MC 1,5/4-ST-3,81)

ports.label: AC Power
ports.notes: IEC C20 inlet (20 A max), 100-240 V AC; region-specific cord provided
